# Ryan Zannah

> Ryan Zannah is a web developer, designer and SEO specialist based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with more than five years of experience (freelancing since 2021, graphic designer at the X-Brain Info Tech agency in Kushtia from age 13). He is the founder of QORVAYN, a technology company founded on 10 March 2026 that builds eSkypixx, RYNEKA and GoalWear. He works remotely with clients worldwide and speaks English natively.

- [Contact](https://ryanzannah.online/contact): Email, phone and social links

## Products

- [eSkypixx](https://ryanzannah.online/eskypixx): AI-powered visual and social platform for nature, sky and photography (in development)
- [RYNEKA](https://ryanzannah.online/ryneka): AI operating system concept to help people think, create and automate (concept and planning)
- [GoalWear](https://ryanzannah.online/goalwear): Football jersey and streetwear e-commerce brand (https://goalwear.online)
